description.text: In hand-inked 1990s cel-animation linework, a wide road-level view opens on a snow-covered city street at pale winter dawn.

The street is quiet and deep with packed snow, low drifts along the kerb, dark buildings and bare trees softened by falling snow. The car is already in motion, nose angled slightly toward the viewer as its tyres press fresh tracks into the slush. Snow gathers on the windscreen and along the roofline; the carbon fibre weave reads as a subtle dark pattern under the pale sky. A thin plume of exhaust curls behind the car, and the whole street holds the flat, painted light of a winter morning.
